## Summary

What this adds or changes, in a sentence or two.

## Directory

Which directory the entry lives in (for example `claude-code/hooks/<name>/`).

## Pre-flight

Full checklist: `_template/PREFLIGHT.md`

- [ ] Public models only; nothing unreleased is used or mentioned
- [ ] No internal codenames, go-links, internal URLs, Slack links or employee-only docs
- [ ] No secrets, internal email addresses, customer data or internal metrics
- [ ] No trademarks in the entry name; Dependencies table filled in and every license permissive or flagged; third-party names and assets cleared and listed under Third-party notices
- [ ] Every code file carries the copyright and SPDX header; the entry runs from a clean checkout with placeholder config only
- [ ] Entry README follows `_template/README.md` and the pre-flight scan passes
- [ ] No automation added that pushes to, or opens PRs against, the public repo
